newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar firmer by late close.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar firmer by late close.

text.p: White sugar futures in London were slightly firmer but off the day's highs at the late close on Friday, as New York set the tone for the market.
Benchmark March futures ended $2.40 firmer at $311.50 a tonne, having earlier reached a high of $312.40.
Earlier in the day one big buyer had helped push prices up, but disappointment at New York's lacklustre early trading helped bring prices back, traders said.
Towards the close prices again ticked higher on New York's initiative, but eased back ahead of the late finish.
Traders were happier with the level of activity than they have been for much of this holiday week. "At least we've got some decent volume," one said.
